$comment: Single source of truth for every version, milestone, contract and count quoted in the pkinative documentation. scripts/verify-docs.ts holds package.json, CITATION.cff, CHANGELOG.md and the prose to it; update this file, not the prose. verifiedOn is the date of the last documentation audit.

pkinative.npm: not published; pre-1.0 versions are git tags with an attested release tarball, the first npm publication is 1.0.0

bundle.$comment: Byte budgets for what dist/ ships, enforced by the bundle-check gate step. verify:bundle budgets the re-minified bundle and says nothing about the shipped files. The source maps ship on purpose (tsup.config.ts sourcemap: true): a parsing library's stack traces are worth 2.6x the code when the source is MIT and already public. Every file of dist/ must have an entry, and raising one is a reviewed diff.

playgroundBundle.$comment: The playground runs a byte-for-byte copy of dist/index.js, because pkinative is not on npm before 1.0.0 and there is no CDN to load it from. sourceSha256 fingerprints every src/**/*.ts and tsup.config.ts; bundleSha256 and bytes describe the committed copy. All three are written by `npm run docs:playground` — never by hand — and `playground-freshness` fails when a source changed without a rebuild.

socialImages.$comment: svgSha256 is the SHA-256 of the LF-normalised SVG: it is what proves the committed PNG is not stale. Re-rasterise with the command in the SVG's header comment, then update this hash in the same commit.
